Sep. 23 Chas. Vandenberle - 43 - ruptured apendix rushed to hospital last night ... Enrolled Today at 11:25 50c
Ed Pouquette - 45 - stomach-trouble threatening - has 8 children ... John Wirth - 7 - bronical trouble since 2 yrs. old.
24
Virginia Schroder - 21 - struck by an Auto ... a year ago ... received broken hip-bone ... does not heal ... Mother not Catholic ... but raised children Cath ....
Mr. & Mrs. Jos. Woodlock - she is just back from hosp. after 5th operation ..... infection in head .... now husband taken with appen- dicitis.
Page 302 Sep. 25 26 Jackie Parpart - 3 Dec. 21st next - fell very simply on Thanksgiving day a year ago. Little by little ever since has been failing in his mental and physical faculties. Drs. and science entirely baffeled - a beautiful child - he never cries or complains - only child of his parents.
Mrs. Anna Fogerty - about 40 - a methodist.
26
Thanks - Alex C. Peters - 56 - threatened with loss of 2nd leg - lost one leg when 19. His wife - not Cath. came and enrolled him three weeks ago .... He went back To-day to tell the Dr. that the operation is canciled.
29 John Humbel - 43 - kidney trouble
Leo Kalahar - 55 - tuomer of some kind - cancer feared.
30
Roger DeViane - 10 - very threateningly condition - Hurt at school some 5 weeks ago - the injury seems to developing into sarcomic can- cer .... Enrolled To-day (50c) mother promising more frequent Communion etc.
